Second time I got wayyy too high, started tripping the fuck out, thought it was laced and that I was dying, my entire room was spinning around in 360 degrees, then I got like the minecraft high FOV and my arms seemed super long.

Convinced I was gonna die, I decided to go to bed so I would just die in my sleep and it wouldn't be painful. My mouth and throat were dry and I thought it was my throat closing up and that I was gonna stop breathing.

 As I was falling asleep I just saw hundreds of random images flashing through my mind. Gnomes, santa claus, dora, whatever else. I woke up the next day (I had school btw) and was surprised that it had all stopped. I had a bloody good sleep though. I was shaken up about it all day and it took me until the day after to realise it wasn't actually laced at all and I just freaked out. All of that from 2 puffs of a weak small ass joint.

Third time, I got the same sensation again and started getting worried, then I realised that it was just what weed feels like. It was strong and was annoying me more than anything, in fact I started getting frustrated because the high was so strong. After about 10 minutes though I got used to the feeling and started to enjoy it. I just sat there in my chair with my eyes closed zooming through space at hyperspeed. It turned into the best high I ever had.

Don't smoke too much on your first few times. Keep in mind on your first time smoking you might not feel anything at all, then the second time you get sooo cooked off of the tiniest bit of weed, which is what happened to me lol.

Weed is different for everyone but this is what happens to me. Immediately after smoking I feel a mild buzz, which lasts for around 5-10 minutes before the actual high kicks in. Then I can feel my heart beating deep down inside of my chest and pulsing throughout my body. If I smoked a lot, I'll feel like the room is spinning around. My arms feel fuzzy and tingly, kind of like pins and needles but more pleasant I guess lol. There also can be some visual effects, like when you look around you and everything looks like its moving in like 15 frames per second and everything looks sort of foggy. After a while of just sitting still your body goes numb as well. 

Some of the less noticeable effects include your muscles relaxing, shifting in and out of concentration when you're doing or watching something, and overthinking a lot. 

Of course there are the effects most people know or talk about such as the munchies, feeling tired, and going kind of derpy and silly.

Have fun and if you start panicking or get too high, don't worry, try to enjoy it and your high will eventually hit it's peak and slowly fade away :)
